product.name: ERP
language.label: Language
ui.error.title: Something went wrong
ui.empty.title: Nothing here yet
ui.date.label: Date
error.generic: Something went wrong. Try again, and if it keeps happening, contact support.
error.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.busy: The server is busy. Please try again in a few seconds.
error.notFound.title: Page not found
error.notFound.body: The address may be wrong, or the page may have moved.
auth.signIn.title: Sign in
auth.signIn.loginRequired: Enter your username or e-mail address.
auth.mfa.title: Second step
auth.mfa.totp.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfa.email.intro: We will send a 6-digit code to your e-mail address.
auth.mfa.email.sent: A code is on its way to your e-mail address. It can take a minute to arrive.
auth.mfa.recovery.intro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up the second step. Each code works once.
auth.mfa.remember: Remember this browser for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
auth.mfa.remember.help: You will still enter your password. Do not use this on a shared computer.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
auth.passwordHelp: Use a long password that you do not use anywhere else. A password manager can create one for you.
auth.passwordChange.title: Choose a new password
auth.passwordChange.intro: Your password must be changed before you continue.
auth.enrol.title: Set up the second step
auth.enrol.intro: Your organization asks for a second step when you sign in. Choose how you want to get your codes.
auth.enrol.method: How do you want to get codes?
auth.enrol.method.totp.help: An app on your phone shows a new code every 30 seconds. Works without a network connection.
auth.enrol.method.email.help: We send a code to your e-mail address each time you sign in.
auth.enrol.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
auth.enrol.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
auth.enrol.secret: If you cannot scan it, type this key into the app:
auth.enrol.emailCode: Code sent to your e-mail address
auth.enrol.emailCode.help: To protect your account, we also sent a code to your e-mail address.
auth.enrol.emailOnly: We sent a code to your e-mail address. Enter it to finish.
auth.enrol.reminder.title: Protect your account
auth.enrol.reminder.body: Your organization asks you to set up a second sign-in step by {date}. After that date you cannot sign in without it.
auth.recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
auth.recovery.intro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They are shown only now.
auth.forgot.title: Reset your password
auth.forgot.intro: Enter your username or e-mail address. If an account exists, we will e-mail a link to reset the password.
auth.forgot.done: If an account exists for what you entered, an e-mail with a reset link is on its way. The link works for a limited time.
auth.reset.title: Set a new password
auth.reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
auth.reset.invalid: This link is not valid any more. Ask for a new one.
auth.activate.title: Activate your account
auth.activate.intro: Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
auth.activate.invalid: This activation link is not valid any more. Ask your administrator for a new invitation.
auth.link.incomplete: The link is incomplete. Open it again from the e-mail.
session.warning.title: Are you still there?
session.warning.body: For your security you will be signed out in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
session.expired: You were signed out because the session ended. Sign in again to continue.
home.title: You are signed in
home.body: The application menus will appear here.
